# Loopas

https://loopaas.app | https://idsapp.vercel.app

## About
Aplicación web para gestionar cursos, credenciales y evaluaciones para equipos y organizaciones.

## Key pages
- Home: https://loopaas.app/
- Login: https://loopaas.app/login
- Register: https://loopaas.app/register

## Features
- Course management
- Credential issuance and verification
- Evaluation workflows
- Team and organization management
- Real-time dashboards

## Tech
Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Auth0, Stripe.
